rows.quote: The genome-wide association study (GWAS) summarised data for periodontitis were provided by FinnGen consortium R9 release.17 This study included 346,900 controls and 30,377 clinical periodontitis individuals (ICD-10 K05.30, K05.31, K05.4).
rows.coder_note: Passage line states FinnGen consortium R9 release for the outcome GWAS.

rows.quote: The detailed GWAS information is shown in the original paper.18 For external validation, data on protein Quantitative Trait Loci (pQTLs) were obtained from the UK Biobank.19
rows.coder_note: Row is on the outcome side, but the passages name UK Biobank as the source of validation pQTL data (citation 19); no outcome dictionary row is that dataset.
